text: The Beginner project's measures were plain aggregations, with no filter manipulation. This project needs more, because weekly and company-wide both require changing the filter context, not just aggregating whatever's currently visible.

Start with Total Sales, Total Units, and Order Count, as plain aggregations. Average Order Value wraps DIVIDE instead of a plain slash, so a territory or week with zero orders returns a blank instead of a divide-by-zero error, once slicers can filter a page down to nothing.

Prior Week Sales is the first place CALCULATE actually earns its keep. CALCULATE re-evaluates Total Sales inside a shifted filter context, moved back seven days on the Date table using DATEADD. This only works because Lesson 5 marked Date as the model's official date table.

The Sales Director also wants to see what share of company sales a selected region represents. That needs a measure that ignores the region filter on purpose. ALL of TerritoryDim strips away any filter currently applied through that relationship, recalculating Total Sales as if the whole table were unfiltered, exactly what a company-wide denominator needs.

Here's the detail worth sitting with: with no region filter applied, Total Sales and Total Sales All Regions return the exact same number. ALL has nothing to strip away when nothing is filtered yet. They only diverge once a slicer actually narrows the territory down. Keep that in mind. Next lesson: building the Executive Summary page.
